  Scenario: AC16 A retried or timed-out activity creates no duplicate and no partial set (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the generate operation with an Idempotency-Key already answered once
    When an activity of the generate operation is retried or exceeds its timeout
    Then a retried activity creates no second document, no second decision record and no second event
    Then a timed-out activity answers 503 with MSG-GEN-006 and leaves no partial document set and no decision record
    Then the retry count and the timeout duration are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E2026-CON-AC16) and are not fixed by this baseline
